items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that divides the associated number by given value.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式将关联的数字除以给定值。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that divides the associated number by number referenced via fieldReference.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式将关联的数字除以通过 fieldReference 引用的数字。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that divides the associated number by number extracted via expression.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式将关联的数字除以通过表达式提取的数字。

items.source: Divide by the evaluation results of the given AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 除以给定AggregationExpression的评估结果。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Divide by the value stored at the given field.
items.translation: 除以给定字段中存储的值。

items.source: Uses of ArithmeticOperators.Divide in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: ArithmeticOperators.Divide 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
